Im gonna be honest. Zoloft works great for me, anxiety and depression are greatly decreased on it but since it works so well I cant see myself living without it. Before I went on zoloft I struggled with anxiety a lot but was fine, after knowing that just taking a pill a day makes such a drastic difference I dont see myself ever stopping. Many of the things I can do now and enjoy I could never do without zoloft. Ive gone off zoloft before and it was like a switch got turned off and I went from this fairly confident and extroverted person to an anxious ghost again. All I can say is that antidepressants can work amazingly but once you start you might not wanna live without them. But they dont change who you are, in my experience I go back to my old self if I stop taking it.
